name: Native-order up/gate G8 half
description: Keeps four rows per32-lane SIMD group, the unchanged per-lane K accumulation and simd_sum; varies only independent SIMD groups per threadgroup to8, using exact half FP4 conversion. Targets the measured up/gate region. Native MXFP4 values/scales/routes, BF16 epilogue, native down and prefill fallback preserved. No layout conversion or cache. Must match all11 saved rounding-sensitive boundaries exactly before timing. No speedup claim.
